title: S2a1 v2 memory_hot: bounded HOT memory view generated from the store, never-compact classes, deterministic compaction, memory hot/compact CLI (P1 HOT, P4)
spec:
Create orchestrator/memory_hot.py on top of the merged orchestrator/memory_store.py (S1a, T-1036 on goal/T-0991; read it first: KINDS has 8 kinds including reference, Record.source_tasks is a LIST, tags are [kind, security|gate|daemon|jev|skills|memory|cache words, optional type:<label>], search() has limit=20 default and LIMIT 0 returns zero rows, there is no set_tier helper). Config in pool.toml [memory]: hot_budget_tokens = 3000 (dated comment; tokens estimated as chars/4 like skills_registry._token_estimate), hot_never_compact = ["gotcha:unresolved", "architecture", "decision:constraint"], hot_recent_days = 14. The hot_never_compact labels are conceptual classes that build() special-cases, never literal tag matches: gotcha:unresolved = kind gotcha whose outcome is empty or matches unresolved|open (case-insensitive); architecture = kind architecture; decision:constraint = kind decision with tag security or with the word constraint in title or tags (memory_store never emits a literal constraint tag today). Candidates: fetch ALL warm records with an explicit unbounded accessor: add memory_store.all_records(root, tier=None) returning every row (no LIMIT) and use it; never rely on search() default limit. build(root, budget_tokens=None) -> {"records": [...], "tokens": n, "dropped": [ids], "pinned": [ids], "over_budget": bool}. Pinned (never compacted) = the three classes above plus any record with an open source task: a source task is open when ANY id in record.source_tasks resolves to a bus task whose status is in the open allowlist {queued, held, running}; done, failed, superseded, merged, any other or unknown status, and missing task files count as closed (production task files drift outside bus.STATUSES, so use an allowlist, never a closed-status denylist). The rest is ranked by score = recency (linear decay from 1 at 0 days to 0 at hot_recent_days, 0 beyond) + kind weight (gotcha 3, decision 2, architecture 2, model_note 1, retrospective 1, strategy 1, skill_outcome 1, reference 1) + 1 per open bus task (same allowlist) whose title or scope mentions one of the record's components; ties break by date desc then id. Fill the budget by score after the pinned set; if the pinned set alone exceeds the budget keep it all and report over_budget true (never drop pinned). Each record renders as one compact line (date, kind, title, and for gotchas the first sentence of the body) plus a pointer line 'memory show <id>' only for governing decisions (kind decision) that were dropped. Writes .orchestrator/memory/HOT.md with a first line stating it is generated by memory_hot and must not be edited. Tier marking: chosen records get tier hot, every other hot record goes back to warm, cold unchanged; add memory_store.set_tiers(mapping, root) that updates only the tier column in one transaction (no full row rewrite, sha unchanged) and use it; a compact that changes nothing writes nothing to the db. compact(root) = build and rewrite; idempotent (second run: same HOT.md bytes, same tiers, zero db writes). CLI: `orchestrator memory hot [--json]` (prints the view and the budget report), `orchestrator memory compact` (rebuilds HOT.md, prints pinned/dropped/over_budget). Run migrate + compact against this repository's real memory files and report the token count and the pinned/dropped counts in the result and in docs/hermes-hardening/07-hot-memory.md (also document the class heuristics, the open-status allowlist and the two new store helpers). Do not touch spawn.py: packets are wired in the next task.
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log; test fixtures use synthetic names and values that are not credential-shaped. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Shadow-first: a new adaptive path never changes what a worker sees until its mode is active; shadow only writes decision_log or runs rows. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. The interface contracts of the stage 1 modules are in .orchestrator/plan.md (section GOAL T-0991) and in docs/hermes-hardening/0*.md on this branch; the merged module wins over the plan wording where they differ.
acceptance: tests/test_memory_hot.py::test_pinned_classes_never_dropped (unresolved gotcha, architecture, security-tagged decision and a record whose source_tasks contain one queued task survive a tiny budget with over_budget true; a record whose only source task is superseded is not pinned)

tests/test_memory_hot.py::test_budget_fill_by_score_and_tier_marks (higher-score records chosen first; reference kind scores 1; more than 20 warm fixture records are all considered; store tiers updated via set_tiers; HOT.md written with the generated header)
tests/test_memory_hot.py::test_compact_is_idempotent (second compact: identical HOT.md bytes, identical tiers, zero db writes)
tests/test_memory_store.py::test_all_records_and_set_tiers (all_records returns every row regardless of count; set_tiers changes only tier and leaves sha)

spec_review_risks.issue: Spec never mentions memory_store._goal_from_bus's existing dual lookup (bus.get(id) when root resolves to ROOT, else direct read of root/.orchestrator/tasks/<id>.json catching KeyError/FileNotFoundError). Resolving source_tasks and the open-bus-task score bonus under an arbitrary root needs that same pattern; a naive bus.get(task_id) call works in tests (harness root == ORCH_ROOT) but raises an uncaught KeyError for any other root, e.g. this very worktree's goal repo, so build()/compact() would crash instead of treating the task as closed.

Spec signatures all_records(root, tier=None) and set_tiers(mapping, root) drop the root=ROOT default-kwarg convention every other function in this module uses (add, migrate, search, get, rebuild). Not a correctness bug but an avoidable inconsistency a reviewer would flag.

Score term '+1 per open bus task whose title or scope mentions a component' plus the pinned-by-open-source-task check, as specified, invite re-reading bus/task files per record x per task with no caching directive, i.e. unguarded repeated external (filesystem) calls inside what should be one build() pass. Spec should require computing the open-task set once and reusing it for both pinning and scoring.

orchestrator/repomap.py:101 embeds date.today() in its generated-file header, an established precedent in this codebase. The spec's idempotency claim ('second run: same HOT.md bytes') silently breaks across days if memory_hot.py's header follows that same pattern; a same-day test run would still pass while true idempotency is violated. Spec should state explicitly that the generated header is static text with no date/timestamp.
